changelog: Security review remediation (patch 2). Replaced the over-broad 'no-network / no-file / no-advice' disclaimer with an accurate, consistent capability statement: the skill is a methodology guide that does not bundle executable code or auto-run background tasks; the file I/O, API/MCP calls, audit logs and recommendations described in the body are user-executed in their authorized, compliance-governed environment. Added an explicit sensitive-data retention/access-control governance note and softened explicit operation-advice phrasing (e.g. buy-on-support / stop-loss). Resolves the SDI-1/SDI-4 capability-mismatch and SQP-2/SSD-3 data-control findings from the previous review.
